also: what day of the week is it?

phrases.latin: Quis diēs hebdomadis hodiē est? — Diēs Sāturnī.
phrases.english: What day is it today? — Saturday.

phrases.latin: At enim quō diē hebdomadis nāta es?
phrases.english: What I mean is, on what day of the week were you born?

phrases.latin: In ēdictō cōnsulum, quō ēdīcunt, quis diēs comitiīs centuriātīs futūrus sit
phrases.english: In the consuls’ edict, in which they announce what day the assembly of the centuries will be held

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. date.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 74, 300.
